name: Contextual Relevance
description: How well the generated response aligns with the provided context and topic of the conversation.

name: Interesting Fact Integration
description: How effectively the contestant integrated the provided interesting fact into their response.

name: Coherence and Cohesion
description: How logically structured, coherent, and well-connected the ideas in the response are.

name: Grammar and Language Use
description: How accurate and appropriate the grammar, punctuation, and language use is in the response.

name: Creativity and Engagement
description: How original, engaging, and thought-provoking the response is.
